archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) combined with Archetype 5 (Luxury) for a premium dark mode feel.

rules: Headings: Outfit, ExtraBold or Black, tracking-tighter.
Body: DM Sans, Regular or Medium, leading-relaxed.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter for headings.

layout_spacing.grid_system: Mode A: Tetris Grid for bento layouts. Asymmetry is mandatory.
layout_spacing.optical_alignment: Ensure generous breathing room. Dark mode requires more negative space to feel premium.

design_features.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-2xl or 3xl with bg-white/[0.03] and border-white/[0.08]. Add subtle inner glow using box-shadow inset.
design_features.gradient_blobs: Implement via absolute positioned div elements with bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF007F] via-[#581C87] to-[#00E5FF]. Apply blur-[120px] or blur-[160px] and opacity-20 to opacity-30. Place behind hero text and key sections.
design_features.3d_mouse_tilt_cards: Wrap service/case study cards in `react-parallax-tilt` to create a tactile 3D effect on mouse hover. Apply glare effect if possible.
design_features.floating_phone_mockups: Use `framer-motion` to animate phone mockup frames (`animate={{ y: [0, -20, 0] }}`). Place these dynamically in the hero section.
design_features.animated_marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee`. Mix solid white client logos and outline typography for a 'Kinetic Texture' look. Low opacity for subtlety.

section_blueprints.name: Sticky Navbar
section_blueprints.description: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40). z-50. Minimal brand logo, navigation links, and a primary CTA 'Book a Call' with a gradient border.

section_blueprints.name: Hero Section
section_blueprints.description: Massive H1 'Bold. Dark. Viral.' with gradient text (pink-violet-cyan). Background has large gradient blobs. Right side or background features floating 3D phone mockups. Strong CTA to scroll down.

section_blueprints.name: Marquee
section_blueprints.description: Infinite horizontal scroll of brand logos that have worked with ColabRise.

section_blueprints.name: Services (Bento Grid)
section_blueprints.description: Tetris grid bento boxes for services (Matchmaking, Campaign Management, Analytics). Use mouse-tilt 3D cards. High contrast icons.

section_blueprints.name: Case Studies / Social Proof
section_blueprints.description: Cards showcasing neon-lit portraits of influencers. Metrics highlighted in large typography.

section_blueprints.name: Pricing Tiers
section_blueprints.description: Glassmorphism cards. Highlight the 'Pro' tier with a tracing beam or glowing gradient border. Use clear checkmarks.

section_blueprints.name: Lead Capture Form (Book a call)
section_blueprints.description: Form block connected to the backend. Glassmorphism inputs (bg-white/5, border-white/10). Focus states glow with cyan. Must include data-testid='lead-capture-form'.

section_blueprints.name: FAQ
section_blueprints.description: Accordion style FAQ with glassmorphism panels.

section_blueprints.name: Footer
section_blueprints.description: Deep dark void background. Massive brand text in the background. Clean column links.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text over gradient blobs remains readable (use text-shadow if necessary).
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, forms, and cards MUST include data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='lead-capture-form').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural bento layouts, NOT Shadcn cards, to maintain creative freedom and avoid rigidness.
Use Shadcn for complex interactives like the 'Book a call' form and FAQ accordion, but heavily customize its styles to fit the dark glassmorphism theme.
Ensure the hero gradient strictly uses the #FF007F, #581C87, #00E5FF colors and avoids any banned colors.
Construct the floating phones using a simple wrapper div that uses framer-motion `animate` prop for floating, with a stylized border simulating a phone frame.
